subject: general
question: LAC (Line of Actual Control) is the effective border between India and:
solution:
The correct answer is** __China.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The LAC (Line of Actual Control) is the demarcation that separates Indian-controlled territory from Chinese-controlled territory. 
 
• LAC is the demarcation that was formed after the 1962 Sino-Indian War and is part of the Sino-Indian border dispute.
 
• The term is said to have been used by Zhou Enlai in a 1959 letter to Jawaharlal Nehru.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__** 

 
• **LOC**

 
 
• Line of control(an imaginary line between India and Pakistan )
 
 
 
• **LAC**
 
 
• Line of actual control(effective border between India and the republic of china)
